mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Tool - Send Travel Request
mcp:tool-listener.name: sendTravelRequest
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description:
Sends a travel request message to the AI travel agent broker and posts the response to a Slack channel.
Use this tool to: 1. Forward a user's travel request to the agent broker 2. Receive the agent's response 3. Post the response back to the specified Slack channel
Input: userMessage (the travel request), slackChannel (Slack channel ID), slackUser (optional user ID) Output: Confirmation that the response was posted to Slack

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output text/plain var response = { status: "SUCCESS", tool: "sendTravelRequest", message: "Travel options posted to Slack channel " ++ vars.slackChannel } --- write(response, "application/json")
%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- write({ status: "FAILED", tool: "sendTravelRequest", error: "Bad Request", message: "Request rejected — check input fields", details: payload }, "application/json")
%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- write({ status: "FAILED", tool: "sendTravelRequest", error: "Service Unavailable", message: "Cannot connect to agent broker or Slack API" }, "application/json")

%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- write({ status: "FAILED", tool: "sendTravelRequest", error: "Internal Server Error", message: "Unexpected error in sendTravelRequest tool", details: error.description }, "application/json")
